sources.title: OME-NGFF 0.5 specification
sources.locator: §2.1 axes; §2.3 coordinateTransformations; §2.4 multiscales (2–5 dimensions and per-level scale/translation restriction); §2.6 labels (integer label images)
sources.applicability: Primary standard for new OME-Zarr v0.5 multiscale data and interoperable integer masks. Does not supply the app's full project, vector annotation, undo or provenance model. Per-level multiscale transforms are limited to scale/translation.

sources.title: OME-NGFF 0.4 specification
sources.locator: §2 On-disk (or in-cloud) layout; lines describe hierarchical OME-Zarr using Zarr specification v2 and image/optional-label organization
sources.applicability: Used only to establish that v0.4 is a distinct Zarr v2 generation; an adapter/conversion path must be version-aware. No claim that this proposal has tested v0.4 interoperability.

sources.title: tifffile README and API examples v2026.9.15
sources.locator: Read and write TIFF files; Requirements; Notes on supported subset; examples for return_as='zarr', tile reads, Dask chunks, memmap limitations and OME-TIFF writing
sources.applicability: Independent TIFF parsing/array-access precedent. Shows a bounded-access mechanism for compatible tiled TIFFs and limits/optional codec dependencies; documentation examples do not prove this application's 3 GB memory or latency target.

sources.title: tifffile issue #334: MMStack string z-step regression
sources.pin: Issue #334, opened and closed 2026-09-15; body records affected releases through 2026.9.9
sources.locator: Issue body: versions, Micro-Manager 1.4 string metadata, minimal reproduction, traceback and cause
sources.applicability: Concrete reported failure for a specific archival MMStack metadata convention. Issue report is not itself proof of repair or test execution; those are separately sourced under T3.

sources.title: tifffile fix/test comparison and maintainer release confirmation

sources.title: napari Layer implementation v0.5.6

sources.title: SQLite Atomic Commit In SQLite

sources.locator: §1 Introduction; §§3–4 single-file commit and rollback; §9 things that can go wrong; filesystem/flush assumptions
